title: Require Map Mod Realization Source Topology
forbids: map-mod realization source files outside their finite application, runtime, and map-script owners
why: The released app blueprint closes the package-backed application root. This qualified map-mod overlay closes only the reusable Civ7 realization source interior: finite build and deploy entrypoints invoke qualified installation, runtime file planning, and map-script compilation instead of accumulating root scripts, checked-in output, generated source, or CLI process dependencies.
remediate: Place build and deploy entrypoints under src, host installation under src/runtime/adapters, pure realization mechanics under src/runtime, and map-script compilation under src/runtime/map-script. Remove loose siblings, root scripts, tracked generated sources, checked-in mod output, and calls through a CLI process. Product-specific proof inventories belong to their owning niche rather than this kind law.
message: Map-mod realizations must preserve their closed qualified source topology.
